review.summary: This commit fixes a regression in `incomplete_tag` generation (issue #512) caused by a prior change (#397). The fix modifies `src/hooks.jl` to compare against the stream position before trailing trivia is bumped, rather than relying on the last SyntaxNode consuming all trailing whitespace. This is a clear bug fix restoring previously correct behavior.
review.evidence: Issue #512 clearly documents the regression: `Base.incomplete_tag` returns `:none` instead of the expected `:other` on JuliaSyntax master. The PR #518 body explains the root cause (broken assumption from #397 about trailing whitespace consumption) and the fix (comparing to stream position before trivia bumping). A test file `test/hooks.jl` is modified, indicating test coverage for the fix. The production change is isolated to `src/hooks.jl`.
